blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Corporate training has changed completely in the last ten years. It used to mean sitting in a room with a thick manual and a trainer reading slides. Today, learning happens everywhere: online, on the job, with a coach, or through short videos.

At Czarnikow, the Learning and Development team designs programmes that match real business needs. If the trading desk needs better negotiation skills, the training is built around real trading scenarios. If the operations team needs to learn a new system, they practise on the system itself.

The best training programmes are short, practical, and easy to measure. A good programme answers one question: did people get better at doing their job?

items.q: According to the text, what did corporate training used to mean?
options: Sitting in a room with a manual and a trainer reading slides
items.why: "It used to mean sitting in a room with a thick manual and a trainer reading slides."

items.q: How does the L&D team decide what a programme should contain?
options: By asking trainers what they prefer
items.why: "the Learning and Development team designs programmes that match real business needs."

items.q: What single question does a good programme answer?
options: Did people get better at doing their job?
Did the trainer follow the slides?
items.why: "did people get better at doing their job?" — o critério é o desempenho no trabalho.

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: A long, detailed programme is always better than a short one.
Training should match real business needs.
Learning can happen on the job.
Training should be measured by results.
items.why: Inferência: o texto valoriza programas "short, practical" — duração não é sinal de qualidade.

items.q: The example of the operations team practising "on the system itself" suggests that…
options: learning is most effective when tied to real tasks
operations teams learn faster than traders
items.why: Inferência: o texto usa o exemplo para mostrar que o treino é desenhado em torno da prática real.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry apresentar a nova trilha de aprendizagem para os analistas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Thanks for joining. I want to walk you through the new learning path we are launching for the analyst team next month.

Let me be honest about where we are coming from. Our training used to be one long classroom day, twice a year, with a trainer and a stack of slides. People sat through it, ticked the box, and forgot most of it by Friday. That is not what we are doing this time.

The new path is blended. There is a short e-learning module you can do at your own pace, a live workshop where we practise on real trading scenarios, and then a monthly peer session where you bring your own cases. The idea is simple: you learn something online, you try it in the workshop, and you apply it on the job the following week.

One thing I will stress. The content is the easy part. What decides whether this works is whether you actually use it. So we are not measuring how many modules you finish. We are measuring whether your work gets better. Managers, that means you own this with us — not just HR.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Harry launching for the analyst team?
options: A content library of old slides
items.why: "the new learning path we are launching… The new path is blended."

items.q: How does Harry describe the OLD training?
options: One long classroom day, twice a year, with slides
A mix of videos and workshops
items.why: "Our training used to be one long classroom day, twice a year, with a trainer and a stack of slides."

items.q: What three parts make up the new learning path?
options: A coach, a mentor and a manager
A lecture, a quiz and a survey
An e-learning module, a live workshop and a monthly peer session
A manual, an exam and a certificate
items.why: "a short e-learning module… a live workshop… a monthly peer session."

items.q: Why does Harry say "the content is the easy part"?
options: Because there is very little content in the path
Because applying what you learn is the real challenge
Because the trainer prepares the content quickly
Because the content is too simple for analysts
items.why: Inferência: ele contrasta o conteúdo com "whether you actually use it" — a aplicação é o que decide.

items.q: What does Harry expect from the managers?
options: To leave the programme entirely to HR
To design the e-learning modules themselves
To share ownership of the programme with L&D
To count how many modules people finish
items.why: Inferência: "you own this with us — not just HR" — a responsabilidade é compartilhada.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The programme uses blended learning, so nobody has to choose between online and face-to-face." Blended learning is…
options: learning that happens after work hours
a mix of online and in-person learning
training delivered only by a coach
items.why: Blended learning = aprendizagem híbrida, combinação de online e presencial.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We need to ___ the operations team so they can handle the new pricing system."
items.why: Upskill = aprimorar as habilidades da equipe atual.

items.q: "The audit revealed a serious knowledge gap in risk reporting." A knowledge gap is…
options: a difference between what people know and what they need to know
a missing document in the archive
a break between two training sessions
a delay in delivering the content
items.why: Knowledge gap = lacuna de conhecimento entre o que se sabe e o que é preciso saber.

items.q: Choose the correct term: "Each analyst follows a personal ___ from junior tasks to full deal ownership."
items.why: Learning path = trilha de aprendizagem, o percurso do ponto A ao ponto B.

items.q: "The training is strong, but the real test is application." Here application means…
options: a formal request to join the course
putting what you learned into practice at work
the number of people who signed up
the software used for the course
items.why: Application = aplicação prática, usar no trabalho o que foi aprendido.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre treinamento e desenvolvimento. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "HR still has to sign off on the new training budget." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the learning path to one team at a time." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva, por etapas.

items.q: "Analysts should keep up with the new modules each month." To keep up with means to…
options: finish everything on the first day
stay current and not fall behind
items.why: Keep up with = acompanhar o ritmo, manter-se em dia.

items.q: "People enjoyed the workshop but never followed through on the on-the-job practice." They…
options: failed to carry it to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "Watching one more video will not move the needle on performance." This means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível.
